sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Discogs windows, Videos: the "Playing" label under the player no longer runs into "Video <id>", and each video's title has its proper gap after its ▶ Play tile.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: A long text cell (an editor profile's Bio, an Annotation, edit notes) in a sub-table that starts collapsed now gets its ▶ more toggle when the sub-table is opened. Before, its text was cut off after a few lines with no way to read the rest (reported on https://musicbrainz.org/user/atj).
